subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Reconhecer o uso do imperativo em enunciados de atividades, comandos e instruções.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer formas de verbo no modo imperativo em textos escritos e falados
components.description_en: Recognize imperative mood verb forms in written and spoken English
components.cc_component_description: Recognize and correct inappropriate shifts in verb mood in writing

components.description_pt: Identificar a função comunicativa de imperativos em comandos e instruções
components.description_en: Identify the communicative function of imperatives in commands and instructions
components.cc_component_description: Identify characteristics of various text types and their communicative purposes

components.description_pt: Distinguir o uso do modo imperativo em atividades, comandos e textos instrucionais
components.description_en: Distinguish imperative mood usage across activity prompts, commands, and instructional texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive verb moods

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive mood.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* presentar o definir temas
* describir cómo funciona u ocurre algo
* agregar precisión y detalles
* exponer las características de textos y sus propósitos
* relacionar diferencias en una variedad de textos
